✦ Appearance
Lock In ModeBlack steel, hard white contrast, and a signal-red training accent.
Font size Adjust text for comfort and readability.
App background Choose a coordinated dark palette or use a photo from your device.
Personal wallpaper A dark overlay keeps text and cards readable.
Contrast mode High-visibility borders for clearer screens.
Bold text Increase emphasis across cards and route labels.
Motion Reduce animation or switch to a calmer pace.
Density Choose a tighter or more spacious layout.
Glow Dial the depth and luxury of the interface.
Focus mode Dim inactive panels to keep the active card in view.
